questions.stem: List the elements {multiples of 6 between 10 and 40} in ascending order. Example: 1,2,3 (without spaces)
questions.solution: The multiples of 6 between 10 and 40 are 12, 18, 24, 30, 36.

steps.explain: Identify the multiples of 6.
Select the multiples that are strictly between 10 and 40.
Format as a set without spaces.

questions.stem: List the elements of {odd whole numbers between 0 and 12} in ascending order. Example: 1,2,3 (without spaces)
questions.solution: The odd whole numbers between 0 and 12 are 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11.

steps.explain: Identify all whole numbers between 0 and 12.
Select only the odd numbers.
Format as a set without spaces.

questions.stem: List the elements {perfect squares less than 50} in ascending order. Example: 1,2,3 (without spaces)
questions.hint: Square number is the number multiply by itself.
questions.solution: The perfect squares less than 50 are 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, and 49.

steps.explain: Identify the perfect squares.
Select the perfect squares that are strictly less than 50.
Format as a set without spaces.

questions.stem: List the elements of the set: {two digit numbers ending with 3} in ascending order.
questions.solution: The two-digit numbers ending with 3 are 13, 23, 33, 43, 53, 63, 73, 83, and 93.

steps.explain: Identify all numbers ending with 3.
Select only the two-digit numbers.
Format as a set without spaces.

questions.stem: List the elements {prime numbers less than 30} in ascending order. Example: 2,3,5 (without spaces)
questions.solution: The prime numbers less than 30 are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, and 29.

steps.explain: Identify the prime numbers.
Select the prime numbers that are strictly less than 30.
Format as a set without spaces.

questions.stem: List the elements in the set of months ending in 'y' in chronological order.
questions.solution: The months ending in 'y' are January, February, May, and July.

steps.explain: List all the months of the year.
steps.work: \text{January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December}

steps.explain: Select only the months that end with the letter 'y'.
Ensure they are listed in chronological order.

questions.stem: List the elements {multiples of 7 between 10 and 40} in ascending order. Example: 1,2,3 (without spaces)
questions.solution: The multiples of 7 between 10 and 40 are 14, 21, 28, and 35.

steps.explain: Identify the multiples of 7.

Format as a set without spaces.

questions.stem: Which completed two-way table correctly represents the Venn diagram? In each row, list (has a sibling, does not have a sibling, row total).
options: Sport: 15, 21, total 36; no sport: 12, 5, total 17; column totals: 27, 26, grand total 53.
Sport: 21, 12, total 33; no sport: 15, 5, total 20; column totals: 36, 17, grand total 53.
Sport: 15, 21, total 36; no sport: 5, 12, total 17; column totals: 20, 33, grand total 53.
Sport: 21, 15, total 36; no sport: 12, 5, total 17; column totals: 33, 20, grand total 53.
questions.hint: The overlap is “plays a sport and has a sibling”; the 5 outside both circles belongs in neither category.

steps.explain: Read the Venn regions: sport only \(15\), both \(21\), sibling only \(12\), neither \(5\).

steps.explain: Fill the “plays a sport” row: \(21\) have a sibling and \(15\) do not. Its total is \(21+15=36\).
Fill the “does not play a sport” row: \(12\) have a sibling and \(5\) do not. Its total is \(12+5=17\).
Choose the table with rows \(21,15,36\) and \(12,5,17\), and column totals \(33,20,53\).
